strings.dnd_unavailable: ʻAʻole loaʻa ka huki a me ka hoʻokuʻu. E hoʻohana i ke pihi ma lalo.
strings.strategy_full: ☢  PONO — nā mea a pau me nā ʻole (palekana)
strings.shred_button: H O ʻ O P A U
strings.ssd_warning:
E akahele! Ma SSD, ʻaʻole hōʻoiaʻiʻo ka hana kākau ʻana ma luna i ka hoʻopau ʻana ma muli o TRIM.
No HDD kēia polokalamu.
strings.confirm_text:
E kākau ʻia ka waihona "{name}" ma luna a e holoi ʻia.

Hoʻomau?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
ʻAʻole hiki ke heluhelu i ka waihona:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  UA KĀKAU ʻIA KA WAIHONA MA LUNA A UA HOLOI ʻIA
strings.report_limits:
• ʻAʻole mālama ʻia nā kahawai ʻikepili ʻokoʻa NTFS (ADS).
• ʻAʻole hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻia ka puke moʻolelo USN.
• ʻAʻole pili nā kope aka a me nā hoʻonohonoho kapua
  (OneDrive a pēlā aku).
strings.step_overwrite: Kākau ma luna o ka ʻikepili
strings.step_delete: Holoi me ka hala ʻana i ka pahu ʻōpala
strings.status_full: Ua kākau ʻia nā mea a pau o loko me nā ʻole. ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻihoʻi — ʻike wale nā mea hana i nā ʻole.
strings.status_fast: Ua kākau ʻia ke poʻo, ka huelo a me nā ʻāpana 4 MB ma luna. ʻAʻole i hoʻopā ʻia ke koena, akā ma muli o nā lua, ʻaʻole hiki i nā mea hana o nā mea kūʻai ke hoʻihoʻi piha. No nā palapala huna, e hoʻohana i ke ʻano PONO.
strings.status_empty: Ua hōʻaʻo ka waihona, ʻaʻole pono ke kākau ʻana ma luna. Ua holoi ʻia.
strings.error_permission: ʻAʻole hiki ke komo i ka waihona. Malia paha ua wehe ʻia ma kekahi polokalamu. E pani a hoʻāʻo hou.
strings.error_not_found: ʻAʻole i loaʻa ka waihona. Malia paha ua holoi ʻia.
strings.error_is_symlink: He loulou hōʻailona kēia. ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻopau i nā loulou — e mau ana ka waihona pahuhopu.
strings.error_reparse: He waihona wahi kēia (OneDrive a like paha). Aia kona ʻikepili i ke kapua, ʻaʻole ma ka diski — ʻaʻohe mea e hoʻopau ai ma ʻaneʻi.
strings.error_not_file: ʻAʻole kēia he waihona (he waihona paʻa a i ʻole kekahi mea ʻē aʻe). E hāʻule i kahi waihona.
strings.error_hardlinks: He mau loulou paʻa ʻē aʻe ko kēia waihona ({n} ka nui). ʻAʻohe poʻo o nā loulou paʻa — ua like nā inoa a pau. Inā hoʻopau ʻoe ma ke ala o kēia manawa, e kākau ʻia ka ʻikepili ma luna a ʻoki ʻia i 32 pāʻi, akā e loaʻa mau ana ke koena ma o nā loulou ʻē aʻe. E holoi mua i nā loulou a pau.
strings.error_compressed:
Ua paʻi ʻia, ua hoʻopili ʻia a i ʻole ua lahilahi ka waihona. ʻAʻole hōʻoiaʻiʻo ke kākau ʻana me nā ʻole i ka hoʻopau ʻana i ka ʻikepili kahiko no ka mea mālama ʻo NTFS iā lākou ma ke ʻano ʻokoʻa.

Wehe i ka ʻano: kaomi ʻākau → Nā waiwai → Kiʻekiʻe → wehe i ka maka o "Paʻi" a me/a i ʻole "Hoʻopili". A laila holo hou i HELEKELA.
strings.queue_hint: (a i ʻole e kau i nā waihona i kēia puka makani)
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Ke kū nei ma hope o ka waihona o kēia manawa...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
E luku ʻia nā waihona {count}.
Nui a pau: {size}.

E nānā i ka papa inoa ma mua o ka hoʻomau ʻana.
ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻopau ʻia kēia hana.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Wehe i nā waihona {count} a pau mai ka pila?

ʻAʻole e hoʻopā ʻia nā waihona ponoʻī — ʻo ka papa inoa wale nō.
strings.hardlink_text:
Loaʻa i ka waihona "{name}" nā loka paʻa ʻē aʻe ({nlink} a pau).

E luku ʻia ka ʻikepili no nā inoa a pau.
Akā e waiho ʻia nā koena (32 bytes) ma lalo o nā inoa ʻē aʻe i loko o ka waihona.

Pono paha ʻoe e holoi i kēia mau koena me ka lima.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Hoʻohana i nā loka paʻa a pau i loko o ka pila
strings.queue_report_cancelled_by_user: Ua hoʻopau ʻia e ka mea hoʻohana.
strings.queue_details_title: Nā kikā o ka hana ʻana
